summary: Full backend + frontend validation of the Iteration-75 nine-point update (media-only posts, unified hashtag input, tutorial popup resize, unified composers, multi-image, Settings button position, ColorCustomizer, public /faq, ORAi rebrand). Backend pytest (/app/backend/tests/test_iter75_faq_and_media_posts.py) — 9/9 passing: (a) GET /api/faq returns 11 published items (guest, no auth); (b) Founder FAQ CRUD as stealth — POST/PATCH/DELETE round-trip with TESTAGENT_ prefix + cleanup + unpublish hides from public list + 404 after delete; (c) POST /api/posts with empty content + 2 image_urls (audience object) — post persisted with content='' and image_urls preserved, deleted after; (d) POST /api/images/upload with valid PIL-generated PNG returns 200 with URL. Frontend: /faq loads as GUEST (11 accordions, search filters, contact-support btn, no faq-manage-link). As stealth: Feed composer feed-composer-hashtag-input → chip feed-composer-hashtag-chip-testtag → feed-composer-submit posts a thought → new post renders text + clickable hashtag-link-testtag → clicking navigates to /hashtag/testtag. Image chip feed-composer-type-image reveals feed-composer-image-grid; feed-composer-image-slot-0 opens feed-composer-image-picker with 'Choose up to N images' text + device/URL tabs + input[type=file][multiple] present. Global + bottom-create opens 'What are you creating?' menu with create-image + create-thought. create-image workflow shows create-image-grid + create-image-hashtag-input + create-image-audience + Album title (optional) placeholder (no required title). create-thought workflow shows create-thought-hashtag-input + create-thought-audience + create-thought-text + create-thought-submit — posting adds a normal post with content + clickable hashtag-link-iter75plus and NO 'Thought'/'Image' label prefix. Stealth on /faq sees faq-manage-link → navigates to /admin/faq. /settings has settings-faq-link (→ /faq) and settings-footer-faq-link. /modes exposes modes-color-customizer with modes-color-primary/secondary/reset + 10 primary preset swatches; clicking modes-color-primary-preset-10e670 changes documentElement --primary from #2EA0FF → #10E670; modes-color-reset restores #2EA0FF. Millennium (modes-apply-millennium) + Stealth (modes-apply-stealth) both position profile-settings-gear at top-right of banner card (x≈1470-1490, y≈98-99 on 1920w viewport; position=absolute with 'absolute' class present, confirming index.css .or-btn:not(.absolute) fix). /admin renders 'ORAi Command Center' with zero standalone-'Orion' word matches; /admin/orion header wordmark + nav item both use 'ORAi' with zero 'Orion'/'ORION' standalone matches in body text. All test posts + FAQ entries created during testing were deleted via API.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminOrion right-side STATUS panel displays 'orion-analytics' as the backend Engine identifier and the widget id constant is still ORION_WIDGET_ID='stealth_ai_5a6' with localStorage keys 'orion-cc-quick-favorites' / 'orion-cc-quick-recent'. These are internal/technical identifiers (not the standalone user-facing word 'Orion'), so the rebrand acceptance passes, but the visible Engine=orion-analytics string on the panel is arguably user-facing metadata — consider renaming the engine label to 'orai-analytics' for full rebrand cleanliness (non-blocking).

PostCreate.audience expects a full AudiencePayload object; sending audience: 'public' produces a 422. This is a schema contract issue only if a client sends the string form. Feed + '+' modals both send the object form correctly. Documenting for future clients.

Frontend tutorial popup lifecycle is server-eligibility driven and mounts globally inside <Layout>. It can appear on /feed on first login; tests should always dismiss it before touching composer elements (used tutorial-close/finish/skip fallbacks — worked).
seed_data_creation: As stealth: created + updated + deleted 1 TESTAGENT_ FAQ entry (cleaned). Created 2 test posts (Iter75 e2e test post with #testtag; Iter75 plus modal thought with #iter75plus) — both deleted via API after verification. Uploaded 1 tiny PNG via /api/images/upload for the upload smoke test (server-side stored image). No leftover TESTAGENT_ FAQ entries. Toggled UI mode to Millennium then Stealth (client-side theme only — no DB writes). ColorCustomizer preset changes stored in localStorage under ourrealm.customColors; reset restored default.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: POST /api/auth/login accepts either email or username in the 'email' field; response has 'access_token'. UI signin: navigate to /signin, fill 'input[placeholder*="Email or username"]' + password input, click 'button:has-text(SIGN IN)'. Always page.context.clear_cookies() first. Feed composer testids: feed-composer-text, feed-composer-hashtag-input, feed-composer-hashtag-chip-<tag>, feed-composer-submit, feed-composer-type-image, feed-composer-image-grid, feed-composer-image-slot-<n>, feed-composer-image-picker. + modal testids: bottom-create → create-image/create-thought/create-video/create-live/create-sound/create-poll/create-link → create-<id>-hashtag-input, create-<id>-audience, create-<id>-submit; thought text is create-thought-text; image album has create-image-grid + create-image-title (Album title (optional)). Color presets: [data-testid^='modes-color-primary-preset-'] + secondary variant (10 each, hex-suffixed lowercase without #). PostCreate.audience MUST be object {visibility, user_ids, friend_group_ids?} not a bare string. /admin/orion still uses internal ORION_WIDGET_ID='stealth_ai_5a6' constant + Engine label 'orion-analytics' — these are technical strings, not the standalone user-visible 'Orion' word.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 9 backend endpoints and all 12 frontend review-request scenarios pass end-to-end. The 9-point update ships correctly: media-only posts respect empty content, hashtag input is unified across inline+modal composers, FAQ page is public and admin-manageable, ColorCustomizer live-updates --primary via inline documentElement styles, Millennium/Stealth Settings gear uses .absolute class to escape the .or-btn:not(.absolute) rule and lands top-right of the banner card, and the ORAi rebrand covers all user-visible text on /admin and /admin/orion.
